entries.not_relevant_because: The manuscript proves only the generalized Mukai bound ρ(ι−1) ≤ n and its equality case (ρ(ι−1) = n iff X ≅ (P^{ι−1})^ρ); it does not treat any of Hartshorne's candidate conjectures A–G (subvarieties of P^n and their complete intersection property, rank-2 bundles, the ample-tangent-bundle conjecture, local algebra, or curves in P^3), and its nearest contact, the ρ = 1 equality case recovering P^n from pseudoindex n+1, rests on a different hypothesis from ample tangent bundle and is not presented as extending Mori's theorem, which the text never cites.
